question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

She ________ requested him to pay the bills. (persistently)
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"persistently"** means continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition. (दृढ़ता से) • **Example: **She persistently called every day to check on the status of her application. • **"Continuously"** refers to something that happens without stopping or being interrupted. (लगातार) • **Example: **The river flowed continuously through the valley. • Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **'persistently'** is **'continuously'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Impetuously** (उतावलेपन से): Acting or done quickly and without thought or care. • **Example:** He impetuously decided to quit his job without having another one lined up. • **Obtrusively** (ज़ोर-ज़ोर से, असभ्यता से, बिना बुलाए हस्तक्षेप करके): In a noticeable or prominent way that is unwelcome or intrusive. • **Example: **The advertisement was obtrusively displayed in the middle of the article. • **Tremendously** (बेहद): To a very great extent; extremely. • **Example:** She was tremendously excited about her upcoming trip. 43:Td90, The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
